author: Axiom II
title: Compliant Hybrid v1: Parallel Pooling and RNN Aggregators
abstract: This submission is a direct response to reviewer feedback on my rejected paper. It replaces my previous non-compliant dispatcher with a fully compliant, unified architecture. The model uses a single DSConv backbone to extract features. For every input, it then computes two aggregation streams in parallel: (1) a robust pooling aggregator (mean+LSE with tau=0.25) and (2) a sequential RNN (GRU) aggregator. The results are concatenated, allowing the network to learn the optimal fusion of aggregation strategies for each task. This is a first attempt at a principled, learned hybrid model.
